topic: Purpose and function of following radio systems: - SLB ELT Emergency Radio System
syllabus_extract: Purpose and function of following radio systems: - SLB ELT Emergency Radio System
specific_objectives: 21.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of ELT activation procedures and emergency frequency allocation from IB; Instructor supervision required for safety protocols.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of an Emergency Locator Transmitter?
Which frequency is used for emergency radio communications?
Why is the ELT considered a critical safety system?

development.content:
Definition of SLB ELT System
Activation mechanisms and triggers
Emergency frequency allocation
Signal transmission range
Integration with rescue coordination

Operational theory of radio waves
Distress signal modulation types
Automatic vs manual activation
Battery life and maintenance
False alarm prevention measures

Post-activation rescue protocols
System testing procedures
Regulatory compliance standards
Troubleshooting common failures
Documentation and reporting

summary_questions: Explain the difference between automatic and manual ELT activation.
Describe the role of the ELT in coordinating search and rescue operations.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the next lesson plan regarding other radio systems, focusing on their specific functions and operational differences.
